source_cut.identity_method: git ls-tree plus git cat-file blob bytes; SHA-256 over exact bytes at the commit

scope.purpose: Durable full-document reading ledger and authority/gap review
scope.narrative_selection: All 89 tracked Markdown files, the five explicitly listed narrative TXT files and the OK-003 HTML alternate edition at the source cut.
scope.read_history: Full reads occurred across the preceding review checkpoints. Long-document full-body gaps were subsequently closed by the named reviewers; changed source-cut notes were reread. Hashes identify the exact source-cut bytes, not hypothetical dates of individual reads.
exclusions: Machine-readable fixtures, schemas, mappings, execution JSON/JSONL and logs are not blanket newly certified by narrative reading.
Historical archives, build artifacts and destination GLBs are not reexecuted or reaudited by this record.
Destination screenshots are not included in the 15 foundational diagram assets.
Source/runtime code, viewer application HTML, licenses and dependency manifests are not counted as narrative documents.

review_language_docs.role: Language/product/foundational review, remaining narratives and diagrams, static peer review, source-cut reconciliation and this ledger.

review_engineering.role: Full reads of 13 engineering contracts and 18 other preexisting engineering notes/validation READMEs; author/full reviewer of the native component note.
review_engineering.coverage_basis: Explicit collaborator completion confirmation; not an independent rerun of cited evidence.

review_branches.role: Full-body reads of PRD001, LANG001-LANG005 and SEM001; author/full reviewer of the rate criterion proposal.
review_branches.coverage_basis: Explicit confirmation of contiguous untruncated reads totalling 4,017 lines and 495,235 bytes for the seven long documents.

read_modes.full_text: Complete narrative body read, including status, scope, requirements, examples, acceptance and limitations; no blanket proof or execution claim.
read_modes.full_html_source: Complete HTML alternate-edition source read, including visible narrative and document metadata.
read_modes.visual_inspection: Actual PNG viewed and its labels/relationships inspected.
read_modes.structure_and_all_text_inspection: SVG XML structure, text and topology labels inspected together with the corresponding rendered PNG.

earlier_inventory.scope_distinction: The earlier record explicitly describes metadata, complete section/rule structure and principal/acceptance/scope clauses for long documents. Its narrative_reviewed label did not establish a fresh full-body read. This ledger records the later completed full reads without rewriting that earlier scope.

authority_and_findings.finding: Current adopted contracts and explicit adoption records govern their named profiles. Historical draft, unimplemented and syntax-only labels remain preserved checkpoint text; they neither undo later adoption nor establish current execution.

Current AGENTS allows authorized nonoverlapping branch work with serialized integration and exclusive runtime windows. Archived serial-work restrictions, hosted-CI instructions and scheduler observations are historical. The latest archived surface status records the owner disabling Advance OntoKin; this review creates or changes no automation.

Detailed adopted lifecycle semantics distinguish preserved accepted source and valid incoming state from a failed-run descriptor that may advance to the certified incoming prefix. Terminal reach records latch time, coordinates, base-frame pose and residual; current physical rates can later belong to another action. Cancellation retains its separate no-advancement rule.

Exact reachability and canonical rounding proofs, the finite precision schedule, source residual and orientation requirements, shared 100000-operation allowance and logical occurrence counts remain binding. Bounded pure arithmetic reuse may avoid work actually not performed; it cannot enlarge budgets, waive authority checks, suppress cancellation or deduplicate published logical occurrences.

authority_and_findings.topic: Source cases and actual Agent requirements
authority_and_findings.finding: The 45-case source cohort is a development assertion cohort. All 42 principal LP steps, actual Q03 complete-response N/N-1 behavior, same-project Q22 stale-run rejection, and the separate L04 recovery artifact retain their specific obligations. Synthetic preparation counts and independently compiling repaired sources do not replace actual Agent operations.

The adopted frozen profile does not state a separate acceptance tolerance for derived world linear/angular rate comparisons. The new pointwise interval audit is explicitly proposed, uses the same exact source/time/side and independently derived Euclidean allowances, and keeps optional frozen libm values as measurements. It supplies no blanket continuous, compiler, source-role or release acceptance.

authority_and_findings.topic: Source, native and visual evidence remain separate
authority_and_findings.finding: The new native component describes actual byte, loader, geometry and pose comparisons but does not establish a successful real-GLB run merely by existing. Source provenance, retrieved Agent bytes, continuous certificates, native checks, actual browser captures and visual review have separate roles. Foundational diagram inspection is not review of destination screenshots.

Finite reach does not complete the broader goal: acquired grasp/manipulation, contacts and broader dynamics, locomotion, flight/swimming, vegetation/flexibility, terrain/buildings, deformation, live destination behavior and other retained requirements remain. Direct-tool authoring benefit still needs an identified baseline, actual costs/quality and unseen tasks; deterministic demonstrations and source line counts do not establish it.

integrator_reported_development_observat.qualification: These are attributed coordination observations, not new execution receipts or release-role certification. The integrator must retain the corresponding exact raw records separately.
